description: Tournai - bulles à verre et points d'apport volontaire is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Tournai. Localisations des bulles à verre sur l'entité de Tournai Données fournies par l'intercommunale IPALLE en date du 19/10/2023 The 2 datasets in this record: Tournai - Bulles à verre; Tournai - Points d'apport volontaire. Coverage: Tournai. The portal lists 2 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Qualité de Vie, Agriculture, Environnement, Administration et Services publics. Its keywords are bulle, verre, environnement. The portal shows 66 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The most recent modification among them is 2025-11-17 on the portal. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste collection, treatment and recycling network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
